Find a DealerFind a Dealer

Product Options

Available Functions

  • Double Cylinder Keyed

Designed to be Personalized.

Blending style and security, Emtek SELECT Entry Handlesets offer hundreds of unique combinations, to find the perfect match for your home’s entryway.

Create a custom look with Emtek SELECT.

Choose from a wide array of finishes and textures to create your own custom look. Assembled to order, Emtek SELECT Entry Handlesets allow you to mix and match elegant finishes and eye-catching textures to create a custom look. Emtek SELECT Entry Handlesets coordinate with other Emtek SELECT products, helping create a cohesive look that flows through the home, from front entry and closet hardware to kitchen and bath fixtures.
